name: What should I prepare before contacting a contractor for a kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contacting a contractor for a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should prepare a list of functional priorities, take rough room dimensions, and collect visual design ideas before scheduling your initial consultation. Make note of current pain points, such as insufficient pantry storage, awkward counter heights, or poor task lighting. If you plan to replace major appliances, write down their target dimensions so framing and cabinetry fit cleanly. Bringing these preferences to your initial discussion with Abraham Becerra helps ensure accurate structural planning, realistic material options, and a tailored work plan right from the start.
acceptedAnswer.description: List your storage and layout priorities, select preferred appliance dimensions, and gather design references to help your contractor plan framing and carpentry accurately.
